mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_job ( id, client_id, original_name, mime_type, original_size, original_width, original_height, megapixels, estimated_memory_bytes, status, failure_reason, original_object_key ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS UUID), CAST(#{clientId} AS UUID), #{originalName}, #{mimeType}, #{originalSize}, #{originalWidth}, #{originalHeight}, #{megapixels}, #{estimatedMemoryBytes}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{originalObjectKey} )

INSERT INTO image_variant ( id, image_id, variant_type, format, file_size, width, height, object_key ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS UUID), CAST(#{imageId} AS UUID), #{variantType}, #{format}, #{fileSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{objectKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(job.id AS VARCHAR) AS image_id, job.original_name, job.mime_type, job.original_size, variant.file_size AS preview_size, CASE WHEN job.status = 'COMPLETED' AND variant.file_size IS NOT NULL THEN CAST( ROUND( (1 - CAST(variant.file_size AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(job.original_size, 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) ELSE NULL END AS reduction_rate_percent, job.original_width AS width, job.original_height AS height, job.megapixels, job.estimated_memory_bytes, job.status, CASE WHEN job.status = 'COMPLETED' AND job.estimated_memory_bytes > 419430400 THEN '고해상도 원본은 그대로 저장하고, 미리보기는 저메모리 샘플링으로 생성했습니다.' WHEN job.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '원본 및 미리보기 이미지 처리가 완료되었습니다.' WHEN job.status IN ('FAILED', 'REJECTED') THEN job.failure_reason ELSE '이미지 처리 중입니다.' END AS message, CASE WHEN variant.id IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/images/' || CAST(job.id AS VARCHAR) || '/preview' ELSE NULL END AS preview_url, job.created_at FROM image_job job LEFT JOIN image_variant variant ON variant.image_id = job.id AND variant.variant_type = 'PREVIEW' WHERE job.client_id = CAST(#{clientId} AS UUID) ORDER BY job.created_at DESC

SELECT CAST(variant.id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(variant.image_id AS VARCHAR) AS image_id, variant.variant_type, variant.format, variant.file_size, variant.width, variant.height, variant.object_key FROM image_variant variant INNER JOIN image_job job ON job.id = variant.image_id WHERE variant.image_id = CAST(#{imageId} AS UUID) AND job.client_id = CAST(#{clientId} AS UUID) AND variant.variant_type = 'PREVIEW'

SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CAST(client_id AS VARCHAR) AS client_id, original_name, mime_type, original_size, original_width, original_height, megapixels, estimated_memory_bytes, status, failure_reason, original_object_key FROM image_job WHERE id = CAST(#{imageId} AS UUID) AND client_id = CAST(#{clientId} AS UUID)
SELECT object_key FROM image_variant WHERE image_id = CAST(#{imageId} AS UUID)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image_job WHERE id = CAST(#{imageId} AS UUID) AND client_id = CAST(#{clientId} AS UUID)
